prompt: Complete DelimitedRecordCodec so toLine writes a Contact as name|phone|note with backslash escaping and fromLine parses such a line back, keeping escaped pipes inside their field.
explanation: Text formats are serialization too, and every delimiter-based format has to answer the question "what if the data contains the delimiter?". The usual answer is an escape character: writing doubles the escape character and prefixes the delimiter, reading treats the escape character as "the next character is data, whatever it looks like". That is why String.split("\\|") is not enough here -- a single left-to-right scan is what keeps escaped delimiters attached to their field.
hints: Escape first, join second: if you join and then escape you would also escape the real delimiters.
In parsing, keep a StringBuilder for the field being built and only end a field on a '|' you did not just see a backslash before.
When you meet a backslash, append the character AFTER it and skip an extra position in the loop.
